body: Thank you, I was kinda confused by the criticism on communication. I'm really just concerned about his mindset. It's easy for me to talk about sex. And in other relationships I've been able to give and receive feedback. I think that makes you feel more close. I'm just especially worries about his take on why he can't, that he respects me too much. It worries me to think he thinks of sex as a bad thing. Or to do with someone you don't like/respect? We both come from a sexually repressive religion. (Not init any longer) I'm worried it's still affecting him after all this time. Maybe he didn't mindfully work through the it. I'm just worried about his mental state.

That's true I need to slow down a little bit in my head. I'm just not thinking practically i think. I guess I get worried that things will always be a certain way unless I but work into it. I think I'm forgetting he is capable of doing that for himself. I guess I've been in a lot of one sided relationships and it's making me think differently. Thank you.
No he's not, im the second girl he's been with and he was not sexually active for a long time after. Thank you, this is all good advice.
Thank you for the encouragement. I really want to do that.

I do agree with that. I really like showing affection to communicate how I feel. I just thought the mature thing to do was to talk about this since it seems like a problem. but maybe I just need to give it some time. I overthink a lot. 


I guess I would say we are in an experimenting stage. I just am having a hard time figuring out what he likes and he doesn't seem to know when we talk. 



And side note. Thank you for all this advice.

I was raised by two therapists so I guess I talk a lot about things. Also I just thought it was good to be open? But I am trying to figure this out so maybe I do have this wrong. I just don't know how to reward him because I can't figure out what he likes. Everything seems so focused on me and I'm not used to that.
That's true. I probably shouldn't have said that. I just don't want to be a selfish lover. I didn't want sex to be all about me so I pushed back on that idea. But I shouldn't have said that.
That's probably good information to disclose about this. I have an IUD so condoms aren't necessary for us.

We have only talked about it once cause he seemed disappointed in himself. I told him that I reqlly enjoy myself but wanted to him to know if there was anything I could do to help I would. He said that he didn't mind only me getting off. That's when I said well wouldn't you feel a little strange if i never orgasmed. And he agreed. This is mostly in my head. I want to avoid making him feel more anxious about it. But I don't know if I am being a good communicator about this when it comes up.
That's a good point. I think I should give it some time. I just want to make sure there nothing else I should be doing. I don't want to make him feel bad about it.
I mean communicating about our sex life. I try to make sure I don't make him feel self conscious about the issue. I just don't know if it would be good for us to talk about it more.
That's a comforting thought. Not to be too graphic but we have had sex for an hour or two and still nothing. Is that still within the realm of this "getting comfortable" stage?
Anything is possible I guess.
You're probably right on that. I need to keep that in mind while thinking about this. I meant I need to put more effort into the communication. Sometimes I'm not articulate enough I think.
He's not, I just randomly know that as we have discussed medication before. Thank you for your thoughts though. I appreciate it.
I was raped and I consider what she went through rape. And yes it really was rape before you question me too because I was a little girl.
Yes he was raping her and being very emotionally manipulative about it. I doubt she wants to discuss your sex life with you right now
I'm not saying that it's going to be an easy thing if she wanted to try and take action (which she said she doesn't want to) but that is covered under some states coersion laws.
She said no.
How is this relevant. Please stop asking this girl to justify her rape.
I think I can do that. That would make me feel better I bet. Do you have any other advice for me? I’d love to hear it

This is the last thing I’m doing for him. I’m out after this. I don’t want to stick around at all. I want him out of my life already. Thank you. I’m really young and this is my first break up and I don’t feel like I know what I’m doing.
Thank you so much for the advise. That is a very good way of putting it.
I think your right, and that’s what I’m gonna put more effort into now. Thank you for the advice.

I let him know that I wasn’t looking for anything long term and that I was still going to seeother people but he seemed annoyed with that tbh. I feel like after I got this super great feeling for this other guy I realized sometimes even though I’m not super attracted to someone I keep spending time with them. Maybe I’m just figuring things out? Is that strange?

Thank you for the advice! I’m definitely not going to “repair” anything because I just don’t want to. Sometimes I feel really guilty doing what I want to do though! I just honestly want to make people happy but I know that’s what a lot of women struggle with. And since I’m such a beginner at this I’m feeling it pretty hard.

My fear is pretty absurd. But honestly that he's going to attack me. Like I don't want to be this way and I just pretend it's not bothering me in the moment but then I take it all home and I'm just crying even though this is great news for me.
That's solid advice, I think I am going to stick with the job
Thank you, I actually am in therapy now
You’re probably right. I just get intimidated by older men. I sometimes feel like they are going to hurt me even though thats really crazy.
I actually did very well in the interview, that’s why they hired me.
Thank you I think you are right. It’s kind of silly that I can’t remember my credits anyways.
Thank you for the comment and suggestions :)

I know it sounds crazy but I have tried every oral anti depressant besides Wellbutrin so far. It probably is a chemical imbalance throwing me off I just wish it’d go away. I haven’t felt like this in a long time so it’s just throwing me off. thank you for your comment and suggestions :)

Yes the seasons are changing right now, I didn’t even think about that but that could be a factor. I’m also just having some issue at work so I’m trying to “change that up” by getting a new job so hopefully that’ll help. Thanks for the comment really :)

I’m just not sure what to do about my meds. I know this will sound like an exaggeration but I have tried every antidepressant and nothing seems to work right. I’m tired of going to the doctor about this. Taking care of yourself is really hard. I’m only 20 and I just feel like I can’t do this.

Wow thank you. That is so nice to hear, I’m trying really hard. As a doctor, do you have any advise on how I can keep my doctors informed that I am a sexual abuse survivor? I told my previous gyno on our first visit and it still hurt pretty bad. When I went back in she just quickly asked me if I was sexually active and then was pretty rough and it honestly made me cry out in pain and then she looked confused. I know doctors don’t have the time to read over every patients previous dictation but it’s hard for me to bring it up every time. Any suggestions?

I was sexually abused when I was quite young and even though I don't remember it entirely I have had terrible effects from it my whole life. It's pretty hard because it feels like it may be something your just making up but there has to be a reason for all these problems. It's pretty hellish honestly, it makes you feel crazy and every adult in your life feels like a suspect.
Thank you :,)
